about_the_game:
Caught in the mulching churn of a frontier world, Fennel, a devil flung far from home, cuts out a living from the cities and towns at the edge of the earth.

Master a suite of unique combat and movement techniques through use of your forked tail. Lose your way in the slithering guts of the colonial undercarriage. Make wealth out of misery.


Brush Burial 2 is an immersive sim with sanguine and spirited systemic gameplay. Your goal, be it a corpse to make or a coffer to clear, is yours to accomplish as you see fit.

Features:

  • Sprawling, interconnected levels with countless paths to the objective, full of hostile or friendly NPCs who react to crimes like stealing, trespassing, and murder.

  • Fast paced, instantaneous combat that is simple but robust, encouraging the use of improvised weapons, environmental objects, and a unique hand-to-hand takedown system.

  • Dozens of unique cosmetics to be unlocked through gameplay challenges, as well as progression through the game's main story.

  • A suite of rogues and rough riders to befriend and betray along your way.

content_descriptors.notes:
Expect some revealing outfits, occasional mildly erotic animations, and some infrequent innuendo in conversation, with implicit undercurrents of sadism and masochism.
Violence and death appear wantonly and irreverently across this game. However, it is not terribly gory or graphic in its presentation.
Drugs and alcohol are used frequently without condemnation.
Crimes in the way of burglary, robbery, and murder are not often portrayed as immoral within the context of this game.

short_description: A murky first-person immersive sim with tightly-wound melee combat and tangled, vertical levels to explore. Use your forked tail to tie your enemies in knots and climb impossible heights. Kill your mark with quickness and cunning, using whatever tools you see fit.
